info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_Update Loan Details API
info.description: The Update Loan Details API enables authorized users to modify existing loan information for a specified loan ID. This operation supports adjustments to various attributes such as the loan amount, interest rate, and repayment terms. It serves loan administrators and customer service representatives who require the ability to maintain accurate loan records. By ensuring that details are up to date, this API ultimately contributes to improved customer satisfaction and supports timely financial decision-making.

put.summary: Update a specific loan by its ID.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update details for a specific loan identified by its unique ID. You can modify various attributes of the loan as required, ensuring to provide the necessary data in the request body.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the loan with ID LOAN-2026-001245. This payload should contain the necessary fields to modify the loan's information, ensuring that all required data adheres to the defined schema.
